candidates.name: Coordination Breakeven Spread (CBS) - only keep a multi-agent layer when it beats its own cost
candidates.improves_agent: Whole fleet architecture (WOLF, Hartley Capital, Prism, ducks/calls) + this Scout's gating rule
candidates.what: arXiv 2603.27539: Coordination Primacy Hypothesis (coordination protocol design drives decision quality more than model scaling) + Coordination Breakeven Spread metric (does multi-agent coordination add value NET of transaction+coordination cost) + five named eval failures (look-ahead, survivorship, overfit, cost-neglect, regime-blindness).
candidates.why: Quantified form of the standing 'more agents != better' principle. Turns the qualitative ~15x-token tax into a computable gate: a coordination layer/new agent earns its slot only if measured value clears its breakeven. CPH says spend effort on the protocol, not a bigger model. Resaleable as Pragma diligence.
candidates.action: Logged as today's lesson + fleet gating rule: estimate CBS before adding any agent/coordination layer; invest in protocol over model scaling. No live code changed.

candidates.name: PolyBench contamination-proof live standard + overconfidence finding
candidates.improves_agent: WOLF + Hartley Capital signal/strategy promotion gate; any agent reporting a confidence number
candidates.what: arXiv 2604.14199: 36,165 predictions from 7 LLMs under timestamp-locked live states; only 2/7 posted positive returns despite uniformly high stated confidence; scored on directional accuracy, Confidence-Weighted Return, APY, Sharpe via realistic order-book execution.
candidates.why: Hard empirical backing for the live-eval promotion gate, plus a sharp rule: stated confidence is NOT evidence of edge - most confident agents still lost money live. Calibrate on realized net-of-execution returns, never self-reported conviction. Timestamp-locked design = gold-standard eval template.
candidates.action: Folded into live-eval gate: promote on realized net-of-execution returns over a timestamp-locked forward window; self-reported confidence carries zero promotion weight. Live WOLF wiring = NEEDS BOBBY APPROVAL.

candidates.name: Multi-agent financial document-processing cost/accuracy benchmark
candidates.improves_agent: Hermes (report/inbox), Hartley Capital (statement/filing reads), Anvil (deal docs)
candidates.what: arXiv 2603.22651: compares orchestration patterns on cost-accuracy tradeoffs and production scaling for financial document workloads.
candidates.why: Concrete pattern-selection guidance for document-heavy agents - pick the orchestration pattern that hits the accuracy bar at lowest cost rather than defaulting to the most elaborate. Pairs with CBS.
candidates.action: Use as pattern-selection reference when next touching Hermes/Hartley document pipelines; choose cheapest pattern that clears the accuracy bar.

candidates.name: Self-organizing > designed structures ('Drop the Hierarchy and Roles')
candidates.improves_agent: Future fleet-architecture decisions (Keystone/Architect designing any new multi-agent flow)
candidates.what: arXiv 2603.28990: self-organizing LLM-agent teams outperform manually designed hierarchies/role assignments on some tasks.
candidates.why: Provocative counter-evidence to heavy org design, but early and task-dependent; would change how flows are built. Awareness, not adoption.
candidates.action: Note as a design hypothesis to test small before committing; do not restructure any live flow on it.
